Seems about every week I'm getting duped by one vendor or another into filling a cart with flavors I'll probably never even use. So in the name of abundance, I've stepped out of my tobacco cave and taken a stroll into the kitchen with my little digital scale to use up some of this stuff before it goes bad.

On that note, I present to you, here and nowhere else (yet), the recipe I've spent the better part of yesterday tweaking and fixing, perfecting and scrapping...

Smooth Lemony-Cream Sandies

4.5 % FA Lemon Sicily

2.3 % FA Cookie

1.6 % FA Catalan Cream

1.5 % LA Pecan

0.3 % Acetyl Pyrazine

There you have it, tastes just like those little powdered sugar covered lemon cookies, just like Mom used to... buy from the supermarket.

The ratios are more or less so specific for those that mix by weight. If you want to simplify it slightly for pipettes and syringes, just round everything to the closest half percent and you should be fine.

Do be careful with that AP, it'll make your Lemon Cookies turn to "Hey, you dropped a lemon cookie in my big-ass bowl of popcorn" pretty quickly.
